item.text: The starter is intentionally minimal. I’m adding a shared database module with durable job, idempotency, and heartbeat tables; the worker will claim and update jobs through SQLite, while the server handles validation and API responses. The page will poll the API and render values through text nodes.

The API and worker logic are in place, including atomic job claiming, restart recovery for interrupted jobs, per-step progress updates, and persisted idempotency keys. I’m finishing the browser page now, then I’ll compile and run the supplied checks to catch interface mismatches.
